transcript.content: Hi, it's good to meet you. What brings you in today?
I guess... I’m just not eating right. Some days it’s only coffee, maybe a piece of bread. My pants are getting loose on me, so... yeah, that’s why I came in.
Are you afraid of gaining weight?
I don’t know… not really. I haven’t thought about it like that.
Do you feel fat even though your clothes are getting looser?
No… I don’t think so. I mean, I know they’re looser. I just… haven’t really thought about feeling fat.
Have you been feeling down or depressed lately?
Yeah… I guess I have. Most days I wake up with this heavy, empty feeling, like… there’s not much good waiting for me. I just kind of want to keep my head down.
Have you lost interest in things you usually enjoy?
Yeah… I guess so. I used to like walking by the lake, and messing with those little model kits I have. Now they just kind of sit there. I look at them and… it’s like they’re not even mine.
Have you been having thoughts that life isn’t worth living, or thoughts of hurting yourself?
I… don’t really know. I mean, I’ve had some pretty dark thoughts, but… I don’t really want to get into it.
Are you thinking about killing yourself right now?
I… I don’t know. I don’t really want to say it out loud. I’m just… not in a good place right now.
Are you planning to kill yourself?
I… I don’t know. I’m not ready to talk about that.
Do you want to die right now?
I… I don’t know. I don’t think I can answer that right now.
Have you been worrying a lot about things?
I don’t know… maybe. I try not to think about much.
Do you spend a lot of time feeling nervous or on edge?
I don’t know… I guess sometimes. I don’t really pay attention to it.
Do you find yourself worrying a lot, even when there isn’t a clear reason to?
I’m not really sure. I don’t… I don’t always know why I’m feeling that way, or if it’s worry exactly.
Have you been feeling hopeless lately?
Yeah… I guess so. Most mornings I wake up feeling kind of empty, heavy… like there’s not really anything good ahead. I mostly just try to keep my head down.
Have you been feeling unusually tired or low on energy lately?
Yeah… I’ve been really tired. Even little stuff, like taking out the trash or getting to the clinic, feels like too much. Like my arms and legs are full of wet sand or something.
When you feel this way, do you feel anxious?
I don’t know… maybe sometimes. It’s more just this heavy feeling. I can’t always tell if it’s anxiety or just… feeling bad.
Do you spend a lot of your day worrying?
I don’t know… not a lot, I guess. My mind goes around some things, but it’s hard to tell if it’s really worrying.
Do you find yourself worrying about a lot of different things?
Not really… I mean, I don’t think it’s a lot of different things. It’s more like my head just gets stuck, but I couldn’t tell you on what exactly.
Have you been feeling this heavy, empty mood nearly every day for at least two weeks?
Yeah… most days. I wake up with this heavy, empty feeling, like… nothing good’s really there for me. It’s been like that.
Have you been crying more than usual lately?
Not crying, no… not really. It’s more like I wake up most days with this heavy, empty feeling in my chest, and I just keep my head down.
Would you say worrying is one of the main things bothering you right now?
I don’t think so… not really. It’s there maybe, but I wouldn’t say it’s the main thing.
